name: Horde (panic event)
description: The Director sends a panic event: a big wave of common infected.

name: Endless horde: on
description: Starts a panic event that never ends until "Endless horde: off".

name: Endless horde: off
description: Panic events end again as usual.

name: More zombies at once
description: How many common infected can be alive at once. Normal is 30. High numbers can slow the game down.

name: Fast zombies
description: Common infected run faster. Normal speed is 250.

name: Tough zombies
description: Common infected get more health. Normal is 50.

name: Change difficulty
description: Easy, Normal, Advanced (Hard) or Expert (Impossible).

name: Zombies back to normal
description: Puts the zombie count, speed and health back to normal and ends an endless horde.

name: Clear the horde
description: Removes every common infected and Witch on the map. Special infected and Tanks stay.

name: Peace and quiet
description: The Director stops spawning wanderers, hordes, specials and bosses until "Director back on".

name: Director back on
description: The Director spawns zombies, specials and bosses again.

name: No special infected: on
description: No Boomers, Smokers, Hunters, Spitters, Jockeys or Chargers until switched off.

name: No special infected: off
description: Special infected spawn again.

name: God mode: on
description: Survivors take no damage until "God mode: off". Affects all survivors.

name: God mode: off
description: Survivors take damage again.

name: Infinite ammo: on
description: Weapons never run out of ammo until switched off. Affects everyone.

name: Infinite ammo: off
description: Ammo runs out again.

name: Low gravity
description: Moon jumps. Normal gravity is 800.

name: Normal gravity
description: Gravity back to 800.

name: Slow motion / fast forward
description: Speeds the whole game up or slows it down. 1 is normal speed.

name: Freeze the survivor bots
description: Survivor bots stand still until "Unfreeze the survivor bots".

name: Unfreeze the survivor bots
description: Survivor bots move and fight again.

name: Message in chat
description: A chat message from the server (shown as Console).
